Predator: Killer of Killers is a 2025 American animated science fiction horror film directed by Dan Trachtenberg from a screenplay by Micho Robert Rutare, based on a story by Trachtenberg and Rutare. It is the sixth installment in the Predator franchise and its first animated installment.
